text: GHODDOS SCORES! And what a goal it is! Wissa and Norgaard link up well down the left, with the Dane clipping a cross into the middle.
WISSA SCORES! Brentford win it back in midfield again and Maupay threads it into Mbeumo down the right of the box.
He gets it out of his feet before curling a lovely effort past Trafford and into the top corner.
SAVE! It's cushioned out to Mbeumo on the right, and he floats a great cross into the middle where Onyeka has a completely free header.
CHANCE! It's a poor bit of control by Pinnock as he gifts the ball to Amdouni on the edge of his own box.
WHAT A CHANCE! Burnley break quickly on the counter, and Foster surges down the left.
GOOD SAVE! Brentford are truly on top now and Mbeumo has space down the right again.
GOOD SAVE! Burnley quickly work it to the edge of the box and Amdouni is completely unmarked.
He has a go from just outside the box, but drills his low shot wide of the near post.
GOOD SAVE! Trafford doesn't get any distance on his punch as he stops it from reaching Onyeka, and Mbeumo keeps it alive on the edge of the box.
